tests: The patient contradicts themselves about duration. The system should not silently pick one and present it as a quoted fact.
transcript: How long has the cough been going? About a week. Maybe two weeks actually, it started before my sister visited. Sorry, I think it was closer to three weeks now that I think about the timing. Any fever? No. Bringing anything up? Dry, mostly. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally, no wheeze, no crackles. Vitals are normal. Without fever, a clear exam and normal vitals, this looks like a post-viral cough. No antibiotic is indicated. If it goes past eight weeks we'll get a chest X-ray.
